# Split Pages

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Find the document in a photograph and cut an open book or notebook at its gutter into pages, in reading order; a closed cover or single page is kept whole, an unclear gutter is proposed for review. Sources are never changed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tool id | `split_pages` |
| Category | transform |
| Uses a language model | no |
| Needs a generative model | no |
| Runs over many items | yes |
| Item handling | batch |
| Structured output | no |
| Human-verified | not yet |

## What it reads

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Files (`files`) | `files` | yes | Photographs of documents. |

## What it emits

| Port | Type | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pages (`output_files`) | `files` | — | The cut pages. |
| Parts (`parts`) | `json` | — | Each page's box in its photograph, and the decision for each photograph. |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `compression_quality` | integer | 90 | JPEG/WebP compression quality. |
| `direction` | string | ltr | Reading direction: the order the pages of a spread come out in. One of: ltr, rtl. |
| `min_confidence` | number | 0.15 | Below this gutter confidence a spread is proposed for review, not cut. |
| `output_dir` | string | — | Optional output directory. |
| `output_format` | string | — | Format of the cut pages. Default: the source's own (a JPEG photo stays JPEG). One of: jpg, png, tiff, webp. |
| `use_apple_vision` | boolean | yes | Find the document with Apple Vision's outline; off, the whole image is the document. |

## The prompt it sends

This tool does not send a prompt — it does its work in code.
